background: Lloyds Banking Group is the holding company of the UK's largest retail and commercial bank, owner of Lloyds Bank, Halifax, Bank of Scotland and Scottish Widows, with almost all of its business in Britain.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, A on average and the weakest at A-, both on a stable outlook, the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 10 Sep 2025; the holding company sits below its ring-fenced bank, as is usual. CET1 of 13.3% is in the bottom quarter of UK majors and has fallen 0.5 points since 30 Sep 2025, which is the figure to watch, while leverage of 5.0% is in the top quarter. Liquidity is middling, with LCR of 143% at the peer median and NSFR of 123% below it. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
